names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιοι Πατήρ και Υιός», with the rank word left off. The page gives neither of them a personal name; on its own page it heads them separately, «Αγιος Πατηρ» and «Αγιος Υιος», and still names neither.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιοι Πατήρ και Υιός»

attestations.note: saint.gr names neither of the two — its page heads them «Αγιος Πατηρ» and «Αγιος Υιος», the holy Father and the holy Son, and gives no name, no place, no year and no persecutor. One entry for the pair, because there is nothing to make two of.
